metricDefinitions.session: Latest 10 sent PTT events, 10 received voice messages and 10 unsent captures in this in-memory session. New session clears measurements only. Missing values are null.
metricDefinitions.captureDurationMs: Captured PCM samples / 16 kHz, including initial and trailing silence. Capture end is a local monotonic timestamp, not necessarily finger release.
metricDefinitions.trailingSilenceMs: Continuous neural non-speech after speech detection; reset by speech. 32 ms windows: the 2000 ms threshold finishes at the first full window at or above 2000 ms.
metricDefinitions.finishReason: MANUAL_RELEASE, TRAILING_SILENCE, MAX_DURATION (15 seconds), or DISCARDED (cancelled, no neural speech, unusable/failed transcription).
metricDefinitions.asrInferenceMs: Recognizer inference wall time; excludes capture and model loading.
metricDefinitions.captureEndToTranscriptMs: Local capture end to completed transcription, including scheduling and inference. Not release-to-transcript.
metricDefinitions.asrRtf: ASR inference time / captured audio duration; below 1.0 is faster than real time.
metricDefinitions.framedBytes: Sent: successful application-frame socket writes plus 4-byte prefixes, including retries and local group fan-out. Received: accepted message frame plus prefix. Excludes TLS, radio/network overhead and other phones' traffic.
metricDefinitions.acknowledgements: Unique intended recipients acknowledging all framed parts of this PTT. Played ACK is distinct from human acknowledgement. Counts remain pending across disconnects.
metricDefinitions.captureEndToPlayedAckMs: Local capture end to each first played ACK per recipient and part; includes delivery, remote playback and returning acknowledgement. Never subtracts clocks from different phones.
metricDefinitions.ttsFirstPcmMs: First synthesis request to first native PCM callback, including initialization and scheduling. All chunks share one record.
metricDefinitions.ttsSynthesisMs: Sum of synthesis call wall times for all chunks and emergency repeats in the playback attempt, including initialization; excludes playback and gaps.
metricDefinitions.ttsRtf: Total synthesis time / total generated PCM duration; below 1.0 is faster than real time.
metricDefinitions.receiptToAudioTrackSubmissionMs: Local receipt to first successful AudioTrack write submission, including queue delay. AudioTrack submission is not exact audible sound onset.
metricDefinitions.playbackDurationMs: Sum of submission-to-drain/stop durations of chunks and emergency repeats; excludes gaps. Replay replaces playback measurements with its latest attempt.
metricDefinitions.footprint: APK plus splits; active ASR pack model/vocabulary files; bundled VAD file; current PSS and highest PSS sampled each second this session. Sampled peak is not an exact allocation peak.
metricDefinitions.processCpuTimeMs: Process CPU time during capture/transcription; may include other threads. CPU time is not CPU percentage.
metricDefinitions.scope: Development measurements only. No WER, intelligibility, idle-listening CPU or benchmark averages. No transcripts, peers, network addresses, encryption data, firmware fingerprints or exception details in exports.
